description: Create a status page on a hyperping.app subdomain, with sections of monitors, healthchecks, components and servers. It is public as soon as it exists: confirm the name, address and services with the user first. Password protection, SSO, a custom domain and a logo are set in the dashboard.

description.description: Short text under the page status.

language.description: Two-letter code of the page's language, e.g. "fr". Default "en".

name.description: Name shown on the page, e.g. "Acme Status".

services.description: Monitors (mon_...) and components (comp_...): UUIDs from list_monitors or get_status_page. Healthchecks (hc_...): from list_healthchecks. Servers (agt_...): from get_status_page, or the end of the server's dashboard address (/servers/agt_...); no tool lists them. Paused monitors are refused, as in the dashboard.

show_response_times.description: Show the response time chart of each monitor. Default false. Never shown for a healthcheck, which has none.

show_uptime.description: Show the 90-day uptime bar of each service. Default true.

subdomain.description: Address on hyperping.app: "acme" publishes the page at acme.hyperping.app.

website.description: Company website, linked from the page header.

name: create_status_page
title: Create status page
